# Quick Reference - Top 15 Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `help` | Show available commands and CORTEX capabilities |
| `plan [feature]` | Create implementation plan with DoR/DoD validation |
| `start tdd` | Begin TDD workflow (RED → GREEN → REFACTOR) |
| `commit` | Stage, commit, push changes with brain protection |
| `align` | Run system alignment checks and integration scoring |
| `optimize` | Optimize CORTEX with SKULL tests and validation |
| `tutorial` | Interactive 15-30 min CORTEX learning program |
| `load dashboard` | Launch dashboard with HTTP server |
| `upgrade cortex` | Upgrade CORTEX to latest version safely |
| `resume [topic]` | Resume previous conversation with full context |
| `feedback` | Submit bug report or feature request |
| `discover views` | Extract element IDs from Razor/Blazor files |
| `run tests` | Execute tests with auto-debug on failures |
| `deploy cortex` | Build and publish production package (admin) |
| `review architecture` | Analyze health trends and forecast debt |


**Full Command List:** See `cortex-operations.yaml` for all 155 available operations
